question: The N2M hinge host is the strongest retrieval result for VCS reliability weights (best full DEV rSum VCS 467.0/467.0/471.0 vs Constant-U 443.6/445.7/436.7, seeds 901/902/903, +26.3 mean, lr_update 30). On the protected-weight NCE host lr_update 10 improved both arms (+6.25/+4.15 rSum) and removed the weight effect (VCS10-constant10 -1.19). Does the hinge-host VCS weighting gain survive the improved LR schedule?
schedule: lr = 2e-4 * 0.1 ** (epoch // lr_update). lr_update 10: epochs 0-9 2e-4, 10-19 2e-5, 20-29 2e-6, 30-39 2e-7 (three decays). lr_update 30 (controls): epochs 0-29 2e-4, 30-39 2e-5. Epochs 0-9 are identical, so the new runs must reproduce the controls there. The change alters decay timing, number of decays and cumulative LR together; it is not a pure timing effect.
new_runs: arms VCS and ConstantU x seeds 901/902/903 = 6 runs, identical to the seed-matched N2M runs except lr_update (same observed pool, same N2M control weight files + locks, same seed, same initial state, same per-epoch permutation stream, same DEV).
reused_controls: N2M lr_update-30 runs s{seed}__VCS and s{seed}__ConstantU (receipts frozen in FREEZE.json); s{seed}__ShuffleVCS descriptive only. Not rerun.

matching.inputs: observed pool, control weights and weight lock against the frozen N2M experiment hashes; vocab and token cache against the inherited freeze; feature files by inherited size/mtime (no content hash was ever supplied). Noise manifests are not opened (read trace forbids them).
matching.initial_state_and_order: N2M did not record an initial-model hash or sample-order hash. Verified functionally: (i) CPU check replays the trainer's own permutation stream and must reproduce batch_mass and batch_ess exactly at all 2266 logged control steps (all 40 epochs, both arms, 3 seeds); (ii) the GPU gate compares step-20/40/60 losses of epoch 0 with the control and requires equal initial-state hashes for the two arms of a seed; (iii) each full run asserts batch_mass/batch_ess equality at every logged step of every epoch and records the epoch 0-9 step-loss, mean-loss and DEV rSum differences to the control (hard failure only if an epoch-0 step loss differs by more than 1e-3 relative = wrong inputs).
matching.nondeterminism: deterministic algorithms are on, as in N2M; whether epochs 0-9 reproduce the control bitwise on a different node is measured and reported, not assumed.

primary_endpoint: best full DEV rSum over 40 epochs (N2M primary; earlier epoch on ties), per seed paired

descriptive: last-epoch rSum, mean of last 5 epochs

budget: N2M per-run RTX wall 6.1-6.5 h (40 epochs incl. full DEV each epoch): ~6.5 GPUh per run, ~39 GPUh for 6; hard limit 10 h per run; gate <= 1 h; outputs on /projects <= 6 GiB (best.pt + last.pt ~0.43 GiB per run).
stopping: all 6 runs complete; no early stopping on interim DEV; failed attempts kept and reviewed, no silent retry or resume.
